row.summary_en: This report compares compression methods against business needs and proposes a validation sequence and conditions for further investment. Quick reading takes about 8 minutes via pages 1–3 and 8–11; in-depth reading takes about 25 minutes via pages 1–11 and the linked original tables. The complete 36-page report retains 10 papers, 20 source figures, experimental data; 12 technical Q&A pairs are included in the PPT notes. Source coverage ends on October 9, 2026; mechanisms and metrics were reviewed on October 15. Missing results are not estimated, and paper results do not represent measurements on this business’s Ascend deployment.
row.summary_zh: 围绕业务质量、容量、吞吐与时延比较压缩技术，提出值得验证的论文、适配工作和停止条件。先阅读报告结论与路线取舍，再按需要查阅方法、实验和原图。实验数字保留论文的模型、设备、数据集和基线；未报告的指标不作估算，昇腾收益仍需业务实测。
row.title_en: October2026 Inference Compression: Technology Choices and Business Validation
